_comment: URLs and image host for the two store pages. Fill in what you have; anything left as PUT_YOUR_URL_HERE is skipped rather than linked to a dead page.
_image_base_note: Where the files in docs/images are served from. For raw GitHub the value is https://raw.githubusercontent.com/notzyvex1/create-coasters-extras/main/docs/images -- but that only works once the repository is public, since raw returns 404 for private repos. Otherwise upload docs/images to the CurseForge project's Images tab or the Modrinth gallery and use that CDN prefix.
